meta.title: VPN questions and answers
meta.description: How to connect, how many devices a subscription covers, which protocol to pick and how refunds work — the common questions about GnomeVPN.

title: Frequently asked questions
intro: The short answers to what people ask most. If yours is missing, email us.

whatIsIncy.q: What is INCY, and why that app?
whatIsIncy.a: INCY is a free client app that GnomeVPN runs through. It has no servers of its own: you paste a link from your account and the app fills up with our servers, your remaining traffic and your renewal date. We picked it because it exists on every platform, including iPhone and TVs, and has been debugged for years.

whyNotOwnApp.q: Why don't you ship your own app?
whyNotOwnApp.a: The honest answer: an app for five platforms means years of maintenance and a constant fight with app stores. INCY has already done that work. We put our effort into servers and speed instead of rewriting what already works. The subscription link stays yours — it works in other compatible clients too.

howToConnect.a: Three steps: install INCY from your store, copy the link from the Connect tab in your account, paste it into INCY. From there the app pulls the server list and keeps it up to date on its own.

whichProtocol.q: There are several servers per country — which one do I pick?
whichProtocol.a: Start with Hysteria2: it is faster and steadier on mobile. VLESS is for networks that block UDP — usually office Wi-Fi, hotels and some corporate networks. WireGuard is in the subscription too: simple and fast, but blocked more often in Russia, so take it if it works better for you. The app labels each entry with its protocol.

howManyDevices.q: How many devices can I use?
howManyDevices.a: Two by default. There is one link per account; a device takes a place the first time its app fetches the subscription. Remove a device you no longer use on the Devices tab of your account or with /devices in the Telegram bot, or add more device places. In INCY, make sure HWID sending is on in the subscription settings: a new device without an HWID is not accepted, because it cannot be told apart from the others.

whichCountries.q: Which countries do you have servers in?
whichCountries.a: The list shows up in the app as soon as you add the link, and refreshes itself whenever we add a node. Switching country is one tap and costs nothing extra.

speed.a: We set no speed or traffic limits. Real speed depends on your own connection and how far the server is — the nearest one usually gives you close to your full line speed.

torrents.a: The tunnel passes them technically. Bear in mind that what you download stays your responsibility, and on some servers the hosting provider may send us a complaint — then we will ask you to switch location.

streaming.a: Usually yes, but we cannot promise it: streaming platforms block server addresses constantly. If one service refuses to open, try another country — that often fixes it.

notConnecting.q: The app will not connect. What now?
notConnecting.a: In order: check in your account that the subscription or the free day is active; refresh the subscription in the app (in INCY, with the refresh button or by pulling down on the server list); try another country or protocol — VLESS if the network blocks UDP. If INCY says the device was not accepted, turn on HWID sending in the subscription settings or remove a device you no longer use on the Devices tab. Still stuck? Write to us with a screenshot.

slowSpeed.q: It used to be fast and now it is slow
slowSpeed.a: Usually it is the server — try a neighbouring country. If every country is slow, test your speed without the VPN; sometimes it is the line itself. If it is fast without us and slow with us, write in and we will look at the node.

linkLeaked.q: My link reached the wrong hands
linkLeaked.a: Open your account, go to the Connect tab and press Rotate link. The old link stops working at once, and every device using an app (INCY or another) is disconnected and removed from the list — add the new link again on each of your devices. WireGuard configs keep working: if one of them may have leaked too, delete it on the Devices tab.

changePhone.q: I got a new phone — how do I move it over?
changePhone.a: Nothing to move. Install INCY on the new device and paste the same link from your account. If you are done with the old device, remove it on the Devices tab of your account to free its place.

howToPay.a: By card on the site, through YooKassa. Access starts the moment the payment goes through, and the app picks up the new expiry date.

refund.a: Yes. If the service is not for you, write to us within 14 days of paying and we will refund the unused period without an interrogation. Planning to delete your account? Request the refund before deleting it.

autoRenew.q: How does auto-renewal work, and how do I turn it off?
autoRenew.a: Auto-renewal only turns on if you saved the card while paying or added it in your account. To turn it off, press Turn off auto-renewal on the Subscription tab of your account: access stays until the end of the period you paid for, and nothing is charged after that.

trial.a: Yes — one full day of complete access: every country, all protocols, no speed limits. No card, and nothing renews on its own. Start it in your account once your email is confirmed (straight away if you signed in with Telegram); it is given once. A day is enough to install the app and test the speed on your own connection, which is the only honest way to judge a VPN. You can subscribe before the day is over — the paid period starts right after it, so the hours left are not lost. If it still is not right after you subscribe, you can get a refund for the unused period within 14 days.

otherApps.q: Can I use Hiddify or another app instead of INCY?
otherApps.a: Yes. Your subscription URL is a standard one, so Hiddify, v2rayNG, Streisand, NekoBox and Clash Meta all read it — the same servers, the same traffic counter, the same renewal date. Copy the subscription URL on the Connect tab (not the INCY link, which only INCY understands) and add it in the app as a subscription. We recommend INCY because we have tested it on every platform, but nothing binds you to it.

referral.q: Is there a bonus for inviting friends?
referral.a: Yes. Your personal link is on the “Invite” tab of your account and under “Invite a friend” in the bot. A friend who comes by it gets bonus days on their first payment, and you get days on your subscription as soon as they pay. The longer the plan your friend picks, the more days you both get — the exact numbers are shown right there. The bonus comes once per friend.

wireguard.a: Yes. WireGuard is already in the subscription for INCY, and for other apps and routers your account's Connect tab has a WireGuard side: pick a country, name the device and download the .conf file or scan the QR code. On Windows WireSock Secure Connect works best, on iPhone and Android AmneziaVPN, on macOS, Linux and routers the official WireGuard app. Each config takes one place in your device limit. WireGuard is blocked in Russia more often than the other protocols: if it will not connect, use INCY.

stillStuck: Still stuck? Email us — we answer within a day.
